newsitem.title: USA: Meridian Medical, Genpharm in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Meridian Medical, Genpharm in alliance.

text.p: Meridian Medical Technologies Inc said Tuesday that it has entered into a long-term strategic alliance with Genpharm Inc, for the marketing of a major undisclosed generic injectable pharmaceutical drug.
Genpharm Inc is a Canadian-based subsidiary of Germany's Merck KGaA.
Meridian will develop and manufacture the drug, which has 1996 worldwide market sales exceeding $100 million.
Under terms of the agreement, Genpharm is granted exclusive Canadian marketing rights for this product and also receives an option for exclusive marketing rights in Europe, Australia and New Zealand.
The parties also have agreed to discuss additional generic injectable drugs to be developed and manufactured by Meridian under this agreement.
